tunings.name: Standard
tunings.description: The universal default tuning for modern music across almost all genres.

tunings.name: Drop D
tunings.description: Standard tuning with the 6th string dropped down one whole step. Allows heavy, one-finger power chords.

tunings.name: D Standard
tunings.description: Every string tuned down exactly one whole step. Creates a heavier, darker tone while keeping chord shapes identical.

tunings.name: Drop C
tunings.description: D Standard tuning with the 6th string dropped down an additional whole step. Heavily used in modern metalcore.

tunings.name: Open D
tunings.description: Strumming all strings open produces a pure D Major chord. Highly popular for slide guitar and ambient folk.

tunings.name: Open G
tunings.description: Strumming all strings open produces a pure G Major chord. Classic rock staple famously used by Keith Richards.

tunings.name: DADGAD
tunings.description: A modal, suspended tuning. Creates an open Dsus4 chord. Huge in Celtic folk, fingerstyle acoustic, and indie rock.

tunings.name: FACGCE
tunings.description: The definitive tuning for Midwest Emo and Math Rock. Forms an F Major 9 chord when strummed open, ideal for complex melodic tapping.
